name: dau-accommodation-link
description: DAU Accommodation Link - Hệ thống Hỗ trợ Tìm kiếm & Đăng ký Phòng trọ Tân sinh viên DAU

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=apps/api & npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
